user_signal.goal_or_constraint: Do not stop at distillation and selection; apply the useful architecture, workflow, methodology and execution primitives to the real control plane with regression-backed changes.

system_impact_map: all current BUSINESS owners through shared operational_hygiene/evolution/artifact_io semantics
falsification_checks: A systemic meta-run that omits existing-capability inspection must fail closed.
A systemic meta-run that asks for decisions without a fact-resolution frontier must fail closed.
A systemic architecture run that omits deletion/simplification and payoff accounting must fail closed.
A non-idempotent mutation that may have been dispatched without verified final state must classify OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, not CONFIRMED_FAILURE.
An idempotency key may permit retry but must not upgrade OUTCOME_UNKNOWN to commit proof.
A claimed thin Universal bootstrap must fit a measured byte budget rather than relying on prose or line count.
A new/uncertain owner integration must require one narrow real or production-equivalent tracer path before broad rollout claims.
A control signal with retrievable facts missing must remain system FACT_GATHERING rather than interrupting the user.
An actionable signal without a stable Agent-ready brief must not be delegated.
A live product trace must not use the same evidence identity as the frozen expected-truth oracle.
Rejected architecture alternatives must remain searchable by concept and state when they should be reconsidered.
Local low-coupling maintenance must remain able to use a lighter path without ritual global overhead.

sources.observation: Capability acquisition should prefer discovery/reuse before building a new mechanism.
sources.rationale: Directly reduces duplicate agents, policies, prompts and tools in the control plane.

sources.observation: Facts and genuine decisions should be separated; retrievable facts should be resolved before consuming user decision bandwidth.
sources.rationale: Directly addresses repeated unnecessary user questioning and operator dependence.

sources.observation: Architecture work should weight payoff and explicitly test deletion/simplification before adding another layer.
sources.rationale: Fits the existing anti-bloat and authority-admission goals while making them mechanically reviewable.

sources.observation: Strong executable-agent architecture measures context footprint, serves current operating knowledge through runtime boundaries, models uncertain mutation outcomes, and verifies final state.
sources.rationale: Context measurement and OUTCOME_UNKNOWN are net-new cross-agent primitives; runtime-served instruction remains an optional owner pattern rather than a Universal mandate.

sources.observation: Expected truth should come from an independent evidence seam where possible, and uncertain integrations should prove one tracer-bullet path before broad construction.
sources.rationale: The existing trajectory evaluator and architecture admission can absorb these without a TDD root policy.

sources.observation: Verify before clarify, turn actionable work into a stable agent-ready brief, and retain rejected decisions as searchable institutional memory.
sources.rationale: These mechanisms directly reduce operator burden and repeated rediscovery in the Signal Plane and maintenance history.

sources.observation: Sparse durable crystallization is useful, but Universal already forbids chat-only material evolution and requires durable maintenance records.
sources.rationale: No new cross-agent authority is needed; existing durability semantics are already stronger than prose-only cross-Skill crystallization.

capability_reuse.rationale: Every selected primitive has an existing semantics owner or harness seam; adding a Top10 root policy, Triage Agent, TDD policy, decision database, or supervisory agent would duplicate authority.

verified_facts: The Top10 library and cross-Skill selection are complete and pinned.
Existing maintenance policy already owns systemic workflow and anti-bloat semantics.
Existing artifact governance already owns write verification and mutation conflict semantics.
Existing Agent Architecture owns thin-router/admission semantics and can measure context without a new context policy.
Existing Signal Plane owns work admission and can implement verify-before-clarify/delegation.
Existing maintenance trajectory evaluator already separates grader execution from product trace but lacked explicit oracle identity.
GitHub audit artifacts are already durable and searchable, so negative decision memory does not need another root database.
The current user request is to continue integration, not to choose among internal implementation details.
unresolved_facts: Real long-run reduction in operator reminders requires later live/heldout trajectories.
Owner-specific mutation runtimes may need local adapters before action-level use.
Runtime-served versioned instructions may outperform repository refresh for some owners, but current evidence does not justify making it universal.
autonomous_next_steps: Strengthen the existing meta-maintenance harness instead of asking the user how to structure it.
Add deterministic mutation-outcome semantics and tests under the existing artifact governance authority.
Measure Universal hot-path footprint under Agent Architecture rather than add context prose.
Add tracer-bullet admission under Agent Architecture rather than a TDD policy.
Extend Signal Plane with verify-first work admission and stable Agent-ready briefs.
Freeze expected-truth oracle identities in the maintenance trajectory corpus.
Extract rejected alternatives from audit history through a narrow searchable decision-memory helper.
Run full control-plane regression and propagate only compatible shared semantics.

alternatives.rationale: Would repeat the learning-without-integration failure: prose changes with no execution or regression behavior.
alternatives.reconsider_when: Only if the target behavior is genuinely documentation-only and no runtime, contract, workflow, or harness surface can express or verify it.

alternatives.rationale: Places each primitive in its current semantics owner and adds mechanical tests without new root authority.
Adds coordination and prompt surfaces while duplicating existing maintenance/artifact/architecture/signal authorities.
alternatives.reconsider_when: Reconsider only if a distinct executor/trace plus heldout measurable lift proves a unique responsibility that existing authorities and narrow harnesses cannot own.

architecture_payoff.current_failure_cost: Repeated user reminders, unnecessary architecture additions, unmeasured hot-path growth, repeated rejected proposals, and unsafe ambiguity around external mutation retries.
architecture_payoff.change_cost: Compatible hardening of existing policy/contracts/harnesses plus narrow deterministic helpers and bounded tests; no new root Agent or policy.
architecture_payoff.expected_payoff: Fewer duplicate mechanisms and user questions, explicit deletion pressure, measured context claims, safer mutation retries, cleaner delegation, and stronger eval seams.
architecture_payoff.deletion_or_simplification_result: Reuse existing maintenance, artifact, architecture, Signal Plane, and eval authorities. Do not add a Top10 policy, capability-acquisition agent, decision agent/database, TDD policy, Triage Agent, or mutation policy.

instruction_surface.reason: The existing startup hook already routes systemic maintenance to repository authority. These primitives are enforceable in runtime/policy/harness and should not enlarge account or startup prompts.

propagation.mechanism: Operational-hygiene/evolution semantics become stricter through existing shared maintenance authority; artifact_io semantics gains OUTCOME_UNKNOWN retry safety without adding a new owner hook. Architecture/Signal/eval helpers stay Universal control-plane mechanisms. No owner business state or lease is mutated by this promotion.

complexity_efficiency.tool_or_remote_read_delta: SYSTEMIC_MAINTENANCE_OR_SIGNAL_ADMISSION_ONLY; all added helpers are local deterministic runtime
complexity_efficiency.migration_compatibility_effect: NO_CONTINUITY_PROTOCOL_BUMP; owner business schemas and leases unchanged

superseded_or_demoted_surfaces: Top10 selection remains learning evidence; it is no longer the terminal state for promoted primitives because they now have production authority/runtime/harness targets.
Repeated rejected architecture proposals should be recovered from searchable audit concept keys rather than chat memory.

second_order_findings: Reuse-before-build is systemic-only in Meta 1.2, so trivial local fixes do not incur unnecessary capability scans.
The decision frontier records unresolved facts and genuine user decisions separately but does not pretend a structural field proves the semantic classification is correct.
Payoff/deletion review reuses the existing complexity budget rather than creating a second architecture authority.
OUTCOME_UNKNOWN permits retry only with idempotence support but never upgrades retry safety into commit proof.
Context footprint uses UTF-8 bytes and a labeled approximation; it does not pretend to be an exact model tokenizer.
Tracer-bullet admission proves only one narrow integration path and cannot certify full owner quality.
Signal work admission is process structure; verify-first does not make the diagnosis semantically correct by itself.
Frozen expected-truth identity prevents evidence-seam collapse but same-repository oracle authorship remains below independent semantic proof.
Negative decision memory reuses audit history and concept keys rather than creating a new authoritative memory database.
No claim is made that all four BUSINESS owners have action-level mutation adapters or owner-local versions of every selected primitive wired yet.

open_gates: Final integrated current-main HIGH-risk CI must pass after final manifest/status alignment.
Owner-local action-level adoption of OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and other shared semantics remains event-driven and must not be fabricated.
Live evidence that decision-frontier/reuse/verify-first gates reduce operator dependence remains open.
Runtime-served versioned operating knowledge remains owner-optional until evidence shows a Universal need.
Frontend-design remains owner-local and has not been promoted into Video/UI owner quality harnesses by this Universal task.
closure.unknown_or_open_world_boundary: The promoted primitives are mechanically enforced in their Universal control-plane surfaces. Future tool/provider semantics, owner-specific action paths, upstream Skill revisions, and real outcome effects may require additional adapters or evidence.
